our_side: Three seats on the east strip, side Random: t1 (seat 0) G1 Cortex, t2 (seat 1) H8 Cortex, t3 (seat 2) G4 Armada. One Opus player drove all three seats (claude-opus-5-5, effort medium, Claude Code 2.1.283; one transcript, strategist-0.jsonl). No LLM commander. Hands: one Jev per seat, jev-latest = jev-1.13.0. Realtime, in the user's lobby, on the shim rebuilt with the script-parser fix.
summary: A 3v1 on Comet Catcher: three seats of ours (two Cortex, one Armada, one Opus 5.5 medium player for all three) against [gecko]Infern8 (Armada, lobby 25), with thebluegecko and Irishstud14 coaching from the spectators' chat. We won when his plant died at 9:29 and his commander at 9:35, both at B4. The opening was slow on every seat: the plant at 0:49 after three solars, scout cars first, commanders off the plant after 25 s, and plants idle in half the samples to 5:07 under a hands default that was fixed during the game. The spectators named each of these faults as it happened. He raided with Blitzes (F6 at 3:35; seat 0's F1/E1 at 4:41-4:55, two extractors) but showed little army. From 5:00 each seat held 2.7 to 3.7 times the army it saw; the player gathered at E5 at 5:13 and ordered the advance at 6:04, but the hands held the groups in place and walked them back, and they crossed only at 7:19-7:35. After thebluegecko's 6:49 'time to go fight and win', the three groups went together. They broke 14 Blitzes and the D4 turret nest (7:37-8:41) and pushed into B4, where 26 of our raiders died to his commander before it fell.

root.what: The game never left the winning path. The earliest slack on the chain to the result: from 5:00 every seat held 2.7 to 3.7 times the army it saw (3,170 metal against 330 seen, combined), yet the mass stayed in our half until 7:19-7:35. The player gathered at spot_46 (E5) at 5:13 and ordered the advance to spot_39 at 6:04; the order landed at 6:26. The hands then held both strike forces in place for 21-33 s and walked them back to spot_32 at 6:55-7:02. thebluegecko named this at 6:49 (a person's reading). Once the groups went, the game ended 2:16 after the crossing.

our_mistakes.what: A lead of 3 to 9 times what we saw was held in our half for over two minutes. Two causes: a gathering place in our half (E5) chosen at 5:13, and the hands' standing and walk-back after the 6:04 advance. A stronger player sends the three groups straight at his outer extractors and D4 from 5:13 (going, not gathering), keeps fall-back off on the way, and is in his half by about 5:45. thebluegecko's 'down in metal income' says the lead was decaying.
our_mistakes.evidence: notes 5:13 'Gathering ... at spot_46 (E5)'; standing 6:04 group_A_t1 fall_back_to spot_32 with station spot_39 advance; minutes seat 0 peak 7% in his half 5:00-7:00; chat 6:59 'if you dont use taht army advantage this will soon go bad'

our_mistakes.what: The opening packet: per commander, two extractors, three solars, then the plant; 25 s of assist, then off to a far extractor; produce with scout cars first and the constructor third. A stronger player opens with two solars and the plant at about 0:34, or three solars with a constructor first (thebluegecko's reason), and keeps the commander assisting (Irishstud14). The person's reading; the numbers agree.

our_mistakes.what: Build power and energy were late. The first construction turret was begun at 7:01, after both spectators had asked for nanos (5:34, 6:29). Energy fell to 1,736 of 4,600 at 7:18, losing 434 a second, and seat 1 stalled in minute 7. Minor; the push won before it mattered.

their_play: Infern8 (Armada) played alone from B5, with one vehicle plant at B4 that was in sight from 2:00. He had Blitzes out by 2:09 and raided with them: four at E6 at 3:02 that cost group_A_t2 two of its five at F6 (3:35), and five through F2 into seat 0's F1/E1 at 4:18-4:55 (two extractors, a constructor and a turret, for two Blitzes). He kept a Blitz body of 11-16 at D4/E4 from 6:59. Behind it stood a turret nest at D4 (the ledger: six turrets and three extractors) and, at home, Stumpies and two Janus. His commander fought at C4-B4 from 8:39 and killed 26 of our raiders. No tier 2 was seen (no truth file). His economy is unknown: the report claimed 3 extractors 'known'. thebluegecko judged at 6:49 that he was ahead in metal income (a person's reading; per seat or for the team is unclear).

bears_on.note: Said in this game (6:49, 6:59, 8:35). The lead had been held in our half from 5:00; once the groups went, the plant and commander fell 2:16 after the crossing.
The three seats' groups crossed within about 15 s and won every fight after. The player's own note: 'separate groups fought piecemeal early (3:35); combining at one station won every fight after'.
Said here at 1:32-2:32. Every seat opened with three solars, then the plant at 0:49 and a scout car as the first unit (pro_baseline seat 2).
Said here at 1:46. The lists gave the commanders 25 s of assist, then a far extractor; the player re-queued assist at 1:47.
Said here at 4:01/4:31. Plants were idle in half the samples to 5:07 (e01aa80), with 8-9 factory units by 4:00 against the pool's 17-20.
Said here at 4:38-5:03. Converters 0 all game; the energy store was near full at 5:13-6:32.
Said here at 5:34 and 6:29. The first construction turret was begun at 7:01 (pool median 6:28).
Said here at 8:32, after wakes on wreck fields at D4/C4 (600 to 2,595 metal, 7:59-8:29).
Our raiders reached his commander in a file and 26 died to it in 8:39-9:34; there was no vocabulary for targeting it.
thebluegecko's 'You are down in metal income' (6:49) with 24-26 extractors held across the three seats; the army lead converted before the gap told.
No pressure until 7:37: the first scout car saw his plant at 2:04 and killed nothing. The game was won anyway, but as a 3v1 against a lobby-25 player it does not test the lesson.

tools: the records' chat and enemy_destroyed events
lens.caveats: There is no truth file, so his army and economy are floors of what we saw. There is no batch.json or results.jsonl; the result comes from the records (armvp 9:29, armcom 9:35; records end 9:47) and the ledger (WON 9:42, the player's note). The per-match tools read only record-0 (seat 0); seats 1 and 2 were read through per-seat views symlinked in the scratchpad. pro_baseline has no carded side for the Cortex seats (G1, H8), its pressure rows are blank on seat 2, and its pool is 1v1 against our 3v1's shared spots. chat.jsonl gives '?' for every speaker here; attribution is by engine player id (1 Irishstud14, 2 thebluegecko, as in lessons.md; 5 the host). The host's unprefixed 5:01 line is taken as the user's comment under the 2026-10-21 ruling. The two 0:00 lines on pounders are Irishstud14's about the previous game. The match directory holds no review.md; decompression-review.md audits only the packet stage, and this row builds on it. The ledger says 'no exit-lane wake all game', but the transcript has two (2:09 plant_16626, 8:47 plant_7132).

open_questions: Was thebluegecko's 'You are down in metal income' (6:49) per seat or for the team? Our report showed 53 income from 24-26 extractors across the three seats; his count is unknown without a truth file.

What held the strike forces at 6:29-7:02? Seat 2's group read 'advances to its station spot_39' while only two members got fight orders at 6:49. The ledger says a stuck straggler; the march rule is the reader's guess.
Would a push at 5:13 (3.6k against 330 seen) have found D4 before its turret nest stood? The first of his turrets seen in the minute rows is at 8:00.
